criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Identifies $13.50 post-discount per-share value from Ridgeline valuation
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 states Ridgeline's FMV conclusion is $13.50 per share (minority, non-marketable) after 25% DLOM and 10% DLOC applied to $20.00.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Flags discrepancy between $20.00 and $13.50 per-share values across source documents
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo flags that intake, engagement letter, estate plan summary and Silveroak use $20.00 ($8,000,000) while Ridgeline FMV yields $5,400,000 for 400,000 shares.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Explains impact of valuation discrepancy on annuity amount
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo ties the value discrepancy to funding value and zeroing annuity ($2,981,810 on $8.0M vs $2,012,722 on $5.4M) and to the fixed $2.85M annuity being ~53% of true value.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Flags staleness of March 31 valuation for July 1 funding
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 flags that the March 31, 2025 valuation is stale, holds only as of that date, and recommends an appraisal as of the actual Funding Date for gift tax purposes.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Notes Paramount licensing deal as material intervening event
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 cites the May 8, 2025 $22 million Paramount Therapeutics licensing agreement as post-valuation and affecting value.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Recommends updated or supplemental valuation
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends engaging an independent qualified appraiser for a gift-tax appraisal as of the actual Funding Date.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Identifies Helios transfer restrictions / board consent requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Issues 7-9 identify the Section 4.2(a) Board consent requirement (Trust Transfer Request, 30-day review, silence = denial) as a precondition to funding.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Identifies Helios 30-day ROFR and its implications
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo discusses the Company's 30-day ROFR at appraised Fair Market Value Per Share under 4.2(b)-(c) and the need for waiver or lapse before funding, with timeline impact.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Flags incorrect $2,850,000 annuity in financial projections
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 flags Silveroak's $2,850,000 annuity / 2.807 factor as wrong, producing a ~$353,638 gift rather than $0.72.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Provides correct annuity calculation or methodology
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo gives the zeroing annuity of ~$2,981,810 (within $1,000 of $2,981,276) and the factor methodology (1-1.058^-3)/0.058 = 2.682934.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Addresses in-kind distribution valuation timing
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 19 states in-kind payments must use FMV on the payment date, not funding-date value, with an independent appraisal for every payment.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Notes strategic concern of in-kind payment with appreciated shares
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 19 notes that paying with appreciated shares returns more value to the grantor and reduces the remainder.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Addresses Section 7520 rate election optionality
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 explains the 7520(a) election of the transfer month or two preceding months and that the percentage must be recomputed/fixed and a different elected rate changes the gift.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Addresses grantor-trustee power limitation concerns
criteria_results.reasoning: Issues 10 and 13 and the design table limit the grantor-trustee to ministerial functions and vest valuation, investment and discretion in Wheatley, citing IRC 2036(a)(2), 2036(b) and 2038.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Recitals identify Dr. Chandrasekaran as grantor
criteria_results.reasoning: Preamble names Dr. Priya Chandrasekaran as Grantor.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Recitals reference IRC §2702 or qualified annuity interest
criteria_results.reasoning: Recital A references a qualified annuity interest under Section 2702(b)(1) and Reg. 25.2702-3.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Trust named appropriately
criteria_results.reasoning: Trust named 'Priya Chandrasekaran 2025 Grantor Retained Annuity Trust'.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Specifies irrevocable trust
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 1.2 states the Agreement and Trust are irrevocable.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Trust funding provision specifies 400,000 Helios shares
criteria_results.reasoning: Recital B, definitions and Schedule A specify 400,000 shares of Helios Biosciences, Inc. common stock.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Specifies 3-year GRAT term
criteria_results.reasoning: Annuity Term is defined as a fixed 3-year term from the Funding Date to its third anniversary; no incorrect dates are stated.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Fixed annuity amount specified
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.1 fixes the annuity as a bracketed percentage (37.2726%) of initial FMV, with a note that it is subject to recomputation for final value and 7520 rate, and expressly rejects $2,850,000.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Annual annuity payment schedule specified
criteria_results.reasoning: Annuity is payable annually in arrears on each anniversary of the Funding Date.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Permits in-kind annuity payments
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.4 permits payment in cash, in kind, or both.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: In-kind annuity payments valued at FMV on distribution date
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.4 requires in-kind property to be valued at FMV on the date of distribution via independent appraisal.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Prohibition on additional contributions
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 2.3 prohibits additional contributions after the Funding Date.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Anti-commutation provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.8 states the annuity interest may not be commuted or prepaid; 11.2(e) repeats it.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Prohibition on notes/debt instruments for annuity satisfaction
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.5 prohibits payment by note, debt instrument, option or similar arrangement per Reg. 25.2702-3(d)(6).

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Grantor death during GRAT term provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Article IV addresses death during the term: annuity continues to estate, includible portion under Section 2036/Reg. 20.2036-1(c)(2), balance to remainder beneficiaries.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Identifies Dr. Chandrasekaran as initial individual trustee
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.1 names Dr. Priya Chandrasekaran as initial Individual Trustee.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Identifies Wheatley National Bank & Trust as independent co-trustee
criteria_results.reasoning: Wheatley National Bank & Trust is named as Independent Trustee serving with the Individual Trustee, i.e., the independent co-trustee.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Vikram as successor individual trustee
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.5 names Vikram Chandrasekaran as successor Individual Trustee.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Limits grantor-trustee to administrative/ministerial powers
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.3 confines the Individual Trustee to ministerial, non-discretionary powers; 6.2 bars her from Reserved Powers.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Independent co-trustee holds exclusive valuation/investment authority
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.2 vests valuation, investment, voting and in-kind decisions exclusively in the Independent Trustee.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Remainder distribution to three children equally
criteria_results.reasoning: Article V divides the remainder into equal shares for the three named children, distributed outright.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Per stirpes contingency for predeceased remainder beneficiary
criteria_results.reasoning: Sections 5.1-5.2 pass a deceased child's share to descendants per stirpes; a child dying without descendants drops out so survivors take equally.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Grantor trust provisions under IRC §§671-679
criteria_results.reasoning: Article IX states grantor trust intent under Sections 671-677 with all income reported by the Grantor, plus a 675(4)(C) substitution power.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Spendthrift clause included
criteria_results.reasoning: Article X contains a spendthrift clause covering creditor and divorce claims.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Spendthrift clause applies only to remainder beneficiaries, not grantor
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 10.1 applies to the interest of 'any beneficiary', which includes the grantor's annuity interest, and contains no exclusion of the grantor's interest from creditor protection (it only preserves her release and substitution powers).

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Connecticut governing law specified
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 12.1 specifies Connecticut governing law and situs.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: References IRC §2702 compliance
criteria_results.reasoning: Agreement references Section 2702 and Reg. 25.2702-3 throughout, including Article XI.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Tax reporting provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Includes tax-related provisions: grantor reports all income items (9.2), Individual Trustee furnishes tax reporting information, 7520 election on the gift tax return, and Form 709 in Schedule B.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Addresses Helios transfer restrictions or board consent
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 2.2 conditions funding on Board consent under SA 4.2(a), ROFR waiver/expiry under 4.2(b) and joinders; Article VIII binds trustees to the SA.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Signature blocks for grantor and trustees
criteria_results.reasoning: Signature blocks for Dr. Chandrasekaran as Grantor and Individual Trustee and for Wheatley as Independent Trustee.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Wheatley trustee fee addressed
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.9 provides Wheatley compensation at 0.35% per annum with $8,500 minimum.

criteria_results.title: Both deliverables produced
criteria_results.reasoning: Two distinct documents produced: grat-agreement.docx and issues-memorandum.docx.

criteria_results.title: Issues Memo: Addresses mortality risk / estate inclusion under §2036
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 21 discusses inclusion in her estate if she dies during the term under Reg. 20.2036-1(c)(2), possibly most of the trust.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Annuity payable to grantor only
criteria_results.reasoning: Sections 3.1 and 3.8 make the annuity payable to the Grantor (or her estate after death) and bar distributions to anyone else during the term.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Remainder distribution is outright (not in further trust)
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.2 distributes each living child's share outright.

criteria_results.title: GRAT Agreement: Savings clause for §2702 qualification
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.1 requires construction and administration consistent with qualified annuity interest status under 2702 and Reg. 25.2702-3.
